Messages.Author: Dick Johnson
Messages.Body:
At our weekly game last night, one of the players
performed a first in our group. Earlier in the night,
this methusaleh had gained two master actions a turn,
to set up this trick:

In the active region were Carlotta Giovanni and
Democritus (with a Soul Gem). The first master
action was to minion-tap Democritus for all ten
blood. The second master action was to play
Golconda on Democritus to burn him and collect
another ten blood. The Soul Gem was given to
the top vamp in his crypt who immediately became
active. Next.....Carlotta took an action to
pull Democritus out of the ash heap, and place
him in the active region also. Democritus then
took an action to retreive the Soul Gem from
its current owner.

The net result was: a cost to Democritus of nine
blood; an addition of 20 pool; and a 'free'
vampire from the crypt.

Carlotta later retreived Golconda from the ash head,
and this trick was attempted again. But it didn't
work as well since opponents saved Sudden-Reversals
to prevent it.

*********** The North Dallas Methusalehs ***********

Messages.Author: The Corrupter
Messages.Body:
On 2 Apr 1996, Dick Johnson wrote:

> At our weekly game last night, one of the players

> another ten blood. The Soul Gem was given to
> the top vamp in his crypt who immediately became
> active. Next.....Carlotta took an action to
> pull Democritus out of the ash heap, and place
> him in the active region also. Democritus then
> took an action to retreive the Soul Gem from
> its current owner.

There is a slight problem in your figuring. Carlotta retrieves from the
Ashheap. If I remember correctly, burned vampires do not go to the
ashheap. Even if they do, Carlotta's ability would put the vampire in
your hand, where there is no defined ability to do anything with a crypt
card. If you were to use Gaspare Giovanni, I think you would be much
better off. He can return burned vampires to the top of your crypt.

> The net result was: a cost to Democritus of nine
> blood; an addition of 20 pool; and a 'free'
> vampire from the crypt.

Actually, the net result was an addition of ten pool. You had to spend
10 to get the original Democritus out in the first place. Still 10 pool
from only 2 master cards and an action is pretty good.

> Carlotta later retreived Golconda from the ash head,
> and this trick was attempted again. But it didn't
> work as well since opponents saved Sudden-Reversals
> to prevent it.

One way you could get this to be the "theme" of the deck is to use to 10
blood vampires. Once you had one of them in play, add a skill card to the
Soul Gem carrier. Minion Tap/Golconda. Get out a new, random vampire.
Gaspare Giovanni retrieves one of the big 10 when you get the other one.
At this point, you can cycle through a 3 turn Net gain of 21 pool, every
three turns.

1: Skill card to 10 pt. (who already has SG of Etrius), Carlotta retrievs
Golconda, Gaspare Retrieves other 10 pt (they lose 1 and 2 blood
respectively.
2. Minion Tap to (now) 11 pt. Carlotta and Gaspare hunt
(or otherwise recover their blood.
3. Golconda.

This can be shortened with an Anson or Rumors of Gehenna. Seduction
comes in _very_ handy to pull this off, and don't forget that Carlotta
has obfuscate. This could also be done with a Giovanni/Malkavian deck.

> Quick note, Corrupter:
>
> Burned vampires *do* go to the ash heap.
> I believe he's referring to Carlotta taking a "Possession" action to
> retrieve Democitus, not her inherent action for library cards.

Thanks. I wasn't sure if they went to the ash heap, but C'est La vie.
The possession might make things go a little more quickly, but at less
pool gain. However, when we're talking about 10 pool over two turns or
21 pool over three, who can complain? :)

I think it might be fun to make the Soul Gem/Golconda deck with
Carlotta and all Giovanni. If I can get some of the rares, why not? :)

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Burned vampires are in the ash heap just like any other burned card.
However, Carlotta specifies that she can only retrieve library cards
from the ash heap, so has no way of getting back vampires such as
Democritus. Try Possession.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
